Hi Liam / Aisha,

Thanks for sending this over — appreciate the timeline. We completed an initial pass on the questionnaire and attached a consolidated response (redwood_vm_response_2026.docx) along with our most recent SBOM export and high-level pen-test summary. Highlights below:

- SAST/DAST: Redwood runs scheduled SAST scans on all service-side repositories (weekly pipelines) and quarterly DAST (staging + canary traffic) for hosted endpoints. We also run DAST on major release branches before production rollouts.
- Patch SLAs: For severity classifications aligned to CVSS/Redwood triage, target remediation windows are: Critical - 72 hours, High/Important - 7 days, Medium - 30 days, Low - next minor release. These are supported by automated dependency scanning and prioritized backfills in our sprint triage.
- Pen test cadence: Third-party pen tests are conducted annually, with scoped internal red-team exercises semi-annually. Summary attached (pen_test_summary_2026.pdf) — we redact client-sensitive details but can provide redacted findings and remediation timelines.
- SBOM: We generate SBOM exports for the runtime artifact set (models + runtime binaries) on every tagged release; we can also provide scheduled exports (weekly/monthly) via secure share. Attached CSV is the latest snapshot (redwood_sbom_v3.csv).

I've looped in Marissa from Security for a deeper technical appendix on triage and incident handling (Marissa — can you add the appendix and the CVE playbook excerpt?). Priyom from Sales will follow up on contract/SLA language.

Are you OK with the attachments as-is, or would you like a screen-share walkthrough of the pen-test remediation tracker this week?

Cheers,

Liam / Aisha — adding a technical appendix per Soojin's note. Summary of key items: 

1) Triage & Severity mapping:
   - Critical (CVE score 9.0-10.0): automatic creation of urgent remediation ticket, pager alert to on-call SRE, mitigation plan within 24 hours, full remediation target 72 hours.
   - High (7.0-8.9): ticket creation within 8 hours, mitigation plan in 48 hours, remediation within 7 days.
   - Medium/Low: incorporated into backlog; 30/next minor release windows.

2) Patch verification & audit trail:
   - All patches are validated in CI (smoke tests + integration tests) and a build artifact is created with the patch diff recorded. Audit logs retained in our internal compliance store for 5 years.

3) SAST/DAST specifics:
   - SAST: We use a multi-tool pipeline (static analyzers + custom rules for model-serving codepaths). Results are triaged in JIRA; false-positive suppression rules are documented per repo.
   - DAST: Scans run against staging and canary endpoints with authenticated scans for admin paths. We maintain an allowlist for fuzzing to avoid noisy results on external integrations.

4) Pen test process & reporting:
   - Annual external pen test (rotating vendors). We provide a redacted executive summary and remediation attachments (non-sensitive). Findings are tracked to closure in our remediation board; closed findings are audited.

5) SBOM & supply chain:
   - SBOMs are generated from build manifests and include direct/indirect dependencies (PURL-normalized). We can provide per-release SBOMs or continuous export feed; we support SPDX v2.2 and CycloneDX formats on request.

6) Emergency patching + mitigation options:
   - For 0-day critical issues affecting hosted customers, we offer emergency hotfix channels and can route affected tenants to isolated instances or apply configuration-based mitigations while the patch is staged.

I've attached a technical appendix with sample triage playbook snippets and audit log examples. Happy to scrub any additional details for redaction.

Regards,
